g.text: Study 09 · full-count reconstruction · no new neural simulation

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #e8edf6

g.text: Cell labels: active plastic edges / total recipient spikes. Color: active edges, logarithmic scale.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #e8edf6

g.text: All six plastic recipients stayed silent throughout test; trained/pristine full-neuron spike counts matched.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #e8edf6

g.text: The few active test edges still had changed weights and altered sampled voltages. Memory was not absent.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: Source spikes do not establish delivered transmission. Sampling at 10 ms does not recover within-bin voltage peaks.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: This identifies a quiet memory pathway on these inputs; it does not prove that increasing its activity improves trading.
